jobs.title: Senior Group Accounting Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description: BAUE UNSER GROUP ACCOUNTING FÜR DIE NÄCHSTE WACHSTUMSPHASE AUF. Black Semiconductor wächst international und stellt sein internationales Reporting zum 01.01.2027 auf IFRS um. Gleichzeitig schaffen wir heute die Finance-Strukturen, die wir für unsere weitere Entwicklung und internationale Expansion benötigen. In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du nicht einfach bestehende Prozesse – Du gestaltest sie mit. Du entwickelst unser Group Accounting, Reporting und unsere Konsolidierungsstrukturen weiter und arbeitest eng mit Finance Leadership, CFO und Geschäftsführung zusammen. WARUM DIESE ROLLE? IFRS-Transformation: Gestalte die Umstellung unseres internationalen Reportings auf IFRS zum 01.01.2027 aktiv mit. Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Entwickle Group-Accounting-, Reporting- und Konsolidierungsstrukturen weiter und schaffe Standards, die mit unserem Wachstum skalieren. Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Du hast die Möglichkeit, Prozesse, Richtlinien und Strukturen aktiv mitzuprägen und Deine fachliche Expertise direkt einzubringen. Internationale Perspektive: Begleite den Aufbau unserer internationalen Gesellschaften und gestalte deren Integration in unsere zukünftige Gruppenstruktur mit. Impact & Ownership: Deine Arbeit schafft die Grundlage für eine belastbare und international ausgerichtete Finance-Organisation. Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit unserem Wachstum kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch bis hin zur Verantwortung für Group Reporting & Consolidation und zum Aufbau eines Teams. Scale-up mit Corporate-Anspruch: Du verbindest die Dynamik eines wachsenden Unternehmens mit anspruchsvollen Finance-Themen und der Möglichkeit, Strukturen von Grund auf mitzugestalten. ÜBER UNS Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen. Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist. UNSERE TECHNOLOGY Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz. Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau. Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie. DEINE AUFGABEN Group Accounting & IFRS: Du baust unsere Group-Accounting- und IFRS-Strukturen weiter auf und entwickelst sie im Zuge unserer internationalen Expansion kontinuierlich weiter. Konsolidierung & Group Reporting: Du verantwortest zentrale Themen rund um Konsolidierung, Group Reporting und die Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten Reporting-Strukturen. Internationale Gesellschaften: Du begleitest den Aufbau und die Integration unserer internationalen Tochtergesellschaften und entwickelst die dafür notwendigen Accounting-Strukturen weiter. Zusammenarbeit & Ownership: Du arbeitest eng mit Finance Leadership, CFO, Geschäftsführung und relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen und bringst Deine Expertise dort ein, wo fachliche Tiefe und Hands-on-Umsetzung gefragt sind. DAS BRINGST DU MIT - Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Group Accounting, Konzernrechnungswesen, in der Konsolidierung oder im internationalen Reporting - Fundierte IFRS-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit internationalen Accounting-Strukturen - Erfahrung mit internationalen Gesellschaftsstrukturen und deren Accounting-Anforderungen - Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung gruppenweiter Accounting-, Reporting- oder Konsolidierungsprozesse - Erfahrung darin, Finance-Transformationen, Veränderungsprojekte oder vergleichbare Aufbauprojekte aktiv voranzutreiben - Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude daran, Strukturen selbstständig aufzubauen - Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse WAS WIR DIR BIETEN Entwicklung: Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch bis hin zur Verantwortung für Group Reporting & Consolidation und zum Aufbau eines Teams. Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens. Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. einem Tag pro Woche in Aachen. Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits. Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll. UNSERE KULTUR Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst. Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung. Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt. Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließ Dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will. Kannst Du Dich in dieser Rolle und in unserem Unternehmen wiederfinden? Let's connect. jobs.title: Senior SoC Architect (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution The Role We are seeking a skilled Senior SoC Architect at Black Semiconductor to drive the architecture of our entire Electronics-Photonics IC (EPIC) SoC, translating the Marketing Requirement Document (MRD) into a complete, internally consistent, and implementable Product Requirement Document (PRD) covering digital, analog, I/O, and memory subsystems. You will own the digital and high-speed I/O subsystem architecture directly, with particular depth in high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet. Working closely with the Analog/RF System Architect, Photonics System Architect, Package Electrical/SI Architect, memory subsystem owner, product management, and engineering teams, you will integrate their subsystem architectures into one coherent overall product architecture. To join our team, you should be excited to - Own the overall EPIC SoC technical leadership from initial concept through production and drive cross-functional technical alignment across photonics, analog, digital, technology, and product teams. - Build and document the overall product architecture, translating the MRD into a complete PRD and ensuring architectural decisions, technical requirements, dependencies, and trade-offs are consistently aligned across teams. - Own the digital subsystem architecture, including core logic, on-chip interconnect fabric, and subsystem partitioning. - Own the high-speed I/O subsystem architecture, with particular depth in high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet, including how protocol layers map onto the physical SerDes implementation. - Partner with the Analog/RF System Architect, Photonics System Architect, Package Electrical/SI Architect, and memory subsystem owner to integrate their architectures and ensure the full-chip architecture is internally consistent and feasible within the target electrical, physical, and packaging constraints. - Drive full-chip performance, power, and area (PPA) trade-off analysis, partner with external vendors/3rd-party IP providers on full-chip validation and characterization teams on product characterization, and make the calls needed to keep the PRD internally consistent. - Present the integrated architecture and PRD to product management and engineering leadership and own it through to sign-off. Your Qualifications ESSENTIAL - 7–10 years of experience in SoC or product architecture roles, with proven SoC/product architecture ownership and demonstrated experience taking a product from MRD-level requirements through a complete, implementable PRD-level architecture covering multiple subsystems and at least one full product architecture cycle. - Deep, hands-on high-speed I/O subsystem expertise, particularly high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet, including how protocol requirements shape physical-layer architecture. - Strong digital subsystem and interconnect fabric architecture experience, including defining on-chip interconnect and digital subsystem partitioning for a complex SoC. - Strong cross-domain integration skills, with the ability to take analog, photonic, packaging, and memory architecture input from peer subsystem owners and integrate it into one internally consistent PRD without needing to personally own those domains. - Experience translating marketing/product-level requirements into precise, engineering-actionable architecture specifications and reasoning about full-chip performance, power, and area (PPA) trade-offs. - Experience with 3rd-party IP vendors, including evaluating and selecting external IPs and design integration partners. - Experience with architecture specification and requirements management tooling for authoring and maintaining the PRD and tracing it back to the MRD; UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet protocol/standards documentation and compliance tooling; architecture and performance modeling tools, including custom or commercial full-chip performance/power models; Python / C++ for modeling, scripting, and analysis; and collaboration and documentation platforms for coordinating input from analog, photonics, packaging, memory, and other subsystem architects into a single PRD. NICE TO HAVE - Previous experience serving as an SoC Chief Engineer, with end-to-end accountability for a product's full-chip architecture, schedule, and quality outcomes. - Familiarity with silicon photonics or electro-optic I/O, and how it changes traditional I/O subsystem architecture assumptions. - Familiarity with advanced packaging, including 2.5D/3D and chiplet integration, and its impact on full-chip architecture choices. - Experience working directly with product management and/or customers to shape MRD-level requirements. - Experience with CXL or other die-to-die/coherent interconnect standards adjacent to UCIe/PCIe. jobs.title: Defect Inspection Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Your Role As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection. You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification. What You’ll Do - Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers - Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes - Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance - Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions - Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams - Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings - Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters - Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification - Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams What You Bring - A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field - 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection - Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly - Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning - Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC) - Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta - Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability - Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities - Proficiency in JMP for statistical analysis, data visualization and DOE - Familiarity with MATLAB or Python is an advantage - jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Engineer at Black Semiconductor to lead the mechanical design, upgrading, and installation of facility plants and mechanical systems. The role covers critical facility infrastructure, including chillers and heat pumps, compressors, Make-up Air Handling Units (MAHUs), HVAC systems, exhaust systems, water distribution systems, and steam generators. You will coordinate engineering companies, vendors, and suppliers to ensure the successful execution of mechanical engineering activities and contribute to the continuous improvement of facility plants and systems. TO JOIN OUR TEAM, YOU SHOULD BE EXCITED TO - Lead the mechanical design, upgrading, and installation of facility plants and mechanical systems. - Coordinate engineering companies, vendors, and suppliers throughout design, upgrading, and installation activities. - Prepare and upgrade plant procedures, control plans, and Out-of-Control Action Plans (OCAPs). - Lead the preparation, modification, and improvement of FMEAs. - Lead root cause analysis investigations and prepare reports using methodologies such as 8D, Fishbone diagrams, and 5 Whys. - Drive problem-solving activities and improvements related to mechanical plants and systems. - Act as an expert in mechanical engineering and be recognized as a technical reference within the organization. YOUR QUALIFICATIONS - 7–10 years of experience in Mechanical Engineering within structured companies, working with significant and critical HVAC systems. - Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, cleanroom HVAC systems, chillers, boilers, heat pumps, Make-up Air Handling Units (MAHUs), gas and liquid flow and pressure, mechanical plants, and exhaust systems. - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. - Ability to calculate pipe dimensions and mechanical plant capacities. - Fluent communication skills in English and German. - Basic knowledge of AutoCAD. - Demonstrated experience in cleanroom HVAC systems and complex mechanical plants. - Proficiency in reading and preparing technical schematics, engineering calculations, and blueprints. - Understanding of BMS (Building Management Systems) software. - Experience in FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and resilience-oriented mechanical system design, ensuring reliability and robustness of critical facility infrastructure. Our work culture People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth.
